vibe: Regulatory-grade, no-nonsense, Australian. Stripe meets WorkSafe.
design_principles: Geometric & Sharp: Border radius is explicitly 0px everywhere.
High Contrast Dark Mode: Deep #0A0A0A surfaces with bright industry-specific accents.
Scannability: Data-heavy content must breathe through generous padding (16px to 24px).
Visible Structure: Use 1px sharp borders to separate sections, no diffuse shadows.

layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #27272A on structural cards and inputs.

Buttons.style: Rectangular (0px radius). Solid fill for primary using industry accent. Transparent with 1px border for secondary. Minimum tap target 48px height.

Cards.header: Eyebrow mono font for category (e.g., / PRE-TRIP), followed by bold title.

Inputs.style: Rectangular, 1px border (#27272A). Background #0A0A0A. Focus state applies industry accent color to border. Min height 48px.

IndustryAlertTile.style: Background #141414, solid left border 4px thick using the user's specific industry accent color.
IndustryAlertTile.layout: Row with icon, title, description, and right-aligned inline action button.

TabBar.style: Background #0A0A0A with 1px top border (#27272A). Active icon uses industry accent color.

login_background.description: Dark atmospheric background for industrial mobile app login screen
login_background.usage: Use as full-screen ImageBackground on the Onboarding/Login screen with an opaque #0A0A0A/80 overlay to ensure text contrast.

logo.description: Minimalist geometric logo icon for safety compliance SaaS named SafeBase
logo.usage: Use on Login screen and Profile/Settings header. Scale to 48x48 max.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build strictly for Expo React Native (SDK 54). Enforce hard edges (0px border-radius) everywhere.
Dynamic Theming: Contextually read user.industry to apply the corresponding accent color to primary buttons, active tabs, inline actions, and the left-border of Alert Tiles.
Do not use generic gray backgrounds; stick strictly to #0A0A0A for the main screen background and #141414 / #1A1A1A for cards and elevated surfaces.
Every actionable element (Pressable, TouchableOpacity, TextInput) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Implement the Concierge AI Chat tab with a distinct system-like chat UI. Keep chat bubbles sharp-cornered (0px).
No soft drop shadows. Create visual hierarchy strictly through surface color lightness and 1px structural borders.
Use system fonts for primary text. Use monospace fonts explicitly for small eyebrow labels (e.g., / DASHBOARD, / TRADES) to enforce the utilitarian, regulatory vibe.
